**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 24 satisfies the preferred ASSIGN position on all material terms:

- **24.1** — Customer-side affiliate and M&A/successor carve-out, consent-free, notice only.
- **24.2** — Vendor cannot assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (reasonableness qualified), and never to a direct competitor of ours.
- **24.3** — Residual assignments are mutual with a not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed standard.
- **24.4** — Expressly negates any Vendor right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service on our change of control — squarely avoiding the walk-away trigger.

Supporting provisions are consistent: §13 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 assignment, and §30.5 lets a permitted successor enforce the Agreement. No competing change-of-control or anti-assignment boilerplate exists elsewhere in the document.
